messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the video's camera setup to a high-angle full-body shot looking down from a front three-quarter view. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the described camera setup and movement, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, and scene unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the video's camera setup to a high-angle full-body shot looking down from a front three-quarter view. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, and scene unchanged. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands, raises both hands to her hair, then slowly turns in place to face the camera before turning back around.","camera":"High-angle, static full-body shot from behind the character.","clothing":"A short, form-fitting blue-and-white patterned dress with an open back and pink slip-on shoes.","hair_color":"Pinkish-red.","hairstyle":"Short hair with a small low ponytail or bun at the nape.","identity":"A 3D-rendered female character with a slim build, seen mostly from behind and in profile.","scene":"An open, sandy or dirt ground with a long cast shadow, a low wall in the background, and a small red vehicle at the upper right."},"uncertain":["Exact facial features are not clearly visible since the character is mostly shown from behind or in profile."]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output is a high-angle full-body shot from above, with the character centered on open sandy ground and a long shadow. The character's dress, hair, shoes, and general turning/hair-adjusting action are preserved, but the background amusement park rides and structures from the source are no longer visible.
arguments.requested_change: Change the camera to a high-angle full-body shot looking down from a front three-quarter view, using the reference for initial direction, placement, and framing, while preserving the character's identity, appearance, action, timing, and scene.
uncertain: Whether the initial viewing direction exactly matches the reference's front three-quarter framing, since the character is mostly seen from behind in the output.
unexpected_changes: The detailed amusement park background was replaced by a mostly empty sandy area with only a low wall and a small red vehicle visible.
